dialogues.title: At the market
dialogues.scene: You are at a fruit stall in a market.

turns.say: Morning! What can I get you?
options: I am a kilo of apples.
A kilo of apples, please.
I can get you apples.
Yes, anything else.
No, I am all.
No, that's all, thanks.
Here you are. Have you got change for a twenty?
Here I am. Three pounds.
Here you are three pounds forty me.
turns.why: Bozuk para sormak için 'Have you got change for …?' kullanılır.

options: You're welcome, nice day!
Thanks, have a nice day!
Thanks, nice change!
turns.why: Teşekkür ve veda; 'You're welcome' teşekküre verilen cevaptır.

turns.say: You too. See you next week!
options: Hello, see you!
Thanks, next week is.
See you, bye!

dialogues.title: At the doctor
dialogues.scene: You are at a doctor's surgery; you have felt sick for a few days.

turns.say: Good morning. What seems to be the problem?
options: I have a stomach ache since three days.
I've had a stomach ache for three days.
I am stomach ache for three days.
turns.why: Süre için present perfect + for: I've had … for three days.

turns.say: Do you have a temperature or feel sick?
turns.tr: Ateşiniz var mı ya da bulantı hissediyor musunuz?
options: I am sick, but no temperature have.
I feel sick but I haven't temperature.
I feel sick, but I don't have a temperature.
turns.why: 'Feel sick' bulantı hissetmektir; olumsuzda don't have.

options: I ate fish at a restaurant.
I eat fish at a restaurant yesterday.
I have eaten fish yesterday.
turns.why: Dün bitmiş eylem: past simple (ate); 'yesterday' ile present perfect kullanılmaz.

turns.say: I'll prescribe some medicine for you.
options: Should I prescribe water?
Should I take it with water?
Do I take the water with?
turns.why: 'Should I …?' tavsiye isteyen doğal bir sorudur.

turns.say: Yes, twice a day, after meals.
turns.tr: Evet, günde iki kez, yemeklerden sonra.
options: All right, two meals a day.
Thanks, I am a doctor.
All right, thank you very much, doctor.
